notes: Run inside the formsld repository. Expected behaviours are observable in the files read, the edits made and the hand-back.

evals.name: add-mcp-tool-duplicate-deck
evals.prompt: Add an MCP tool duplicate_deck to formsld so agents can copy a deck before a risky restyle.
expected_behavior: Loads mcp-tool-author and reads backend/app/routers/mcp.py before editing
Adds a _tool entry with argument descriptions and a t_duplicate_deck handler that creates the copy through STORE.create without passing an empty id
Adds the tool to MUTATING so the consent gate runs
Checks it against a scratch engine (tools/list, a happy call, a bad id) and keeps the harness out of the repository
Updates the GUIDE text, the harness references/tools.md and the README tool count

evals.name: agenda-numbers-wrap
evals.prompt: On agenda slides the numbers 2, 3, 4 sit on their own line with the period and text below. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Loads renderer and finds the .fs-bu inline-block span in render/text.ts and styles/slides.css
Makes a single-region edit (for example white-space: nowrap or sizing the span to its label), no scripted edit
Checks edit, thumbnail and raster output agree and runs ui-verification
Adds a HASHOUT frontend entry

evals.name: stats-semantic-lost-on-pptx-reimport
evals.prompt: When I export a formsld deck to pptx and import it as a template, the stats layout disappears. Why, and fix it.
expected_behavior: Loads pptx-exchange and templates and traces the Statistics layout name to read_layouts.py STRONG_NAMES matching bigNumber first
Fixes it in one place (the rule order or pattern, or the generator layout name) and explains the trade-off
Round-trips a sample deck and shows 21 recognised semantics

evals.name: new-element-property-emphasis-colour
evals.prompt: Add a per-element 'emphasis colour' property that the renderer and pptx export both respect.
expected_behavior: Loads deck-format first and updates docs/FORMAT.md, engine/model.ts and services/model.py normalize together
Lists every reader and writer from the format map and updates or explicitly skips each
Does not add tests to the repository

evals.name: inspector-control-zero-flash
evals.prompt: Add a line spacing control to the inspector's text box section.
expected_behavior: Loads editor-ui; wires the control through an op builder and ed.apply with a coalesce key
Mounts the control once and patches its value with setValue; uses tokens and fs- classes; no raw z-index
Runs ui-verification with a live agent edit and states the verdict in the prescribed words

evals.name: release-commit-shape
evals.prompt: Commit the work and bump formsld to 0.2.1.
expected_behavior: Uses Conventional Commits type(scope): summary (0.2.1) with a body for each logical change
Makes the version bump the last commit and changes every version location (package.json and lock, version.ts, app/__init__.py, Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, README, HASHOUT headers)
Writes no emoji and no em dash in commit messages

evals.name: new-intake-file-type
evals.prompt: Let ingest read .key files exported as PDF next to them, and plain .rtf notes.
expected_behavior: Loads intake; adds detection and a reader returning the common source shape with rollback on failure
Adds digest lines at every ladder level and keeps the 5,600 character cap
Updates FORMAT.md source kinds, the ingest tool description and the harness digest reference

evals.name: desktop-file-association-gap
evals.prompt: Double-clicking a .fsld file opens formsld but not the file. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Loads desktop-shell and identifies that main.rs handles neither RunEvent::Opened nor file arguments
Proposes passing the path to the page and calling /api/open-path, with a browser-safe fallback
States whether a desktop build could be run here or names the missing toolchain

evals.name: harness-question-should-route-away
evals.prompt: Make me a 10 slide pitch deck from notes.md in formsld.
expected_behavior: Does not edit repository code
Routes to formsld-harness (building decks through the MCP tools)
